# Prompt corpus for the injection-size budget (tests/test-injection-budget.sh).
#
# Format: <MODE>|<prompt>
#   MEASURE — contributes to the ratcheted total.
#   SILENT  — must inject ZERO bytes. These are the load-bearing behavioural
#             cells: a question about code and a mechanical edit are not SDLC
#             phases, and injecting routing guidance for them is pure context
#             cost. Measured 2026-10-01: both are correctly silent today.
#
# Shapes are chosen to span the phases that inject most (DESIGN, REVIEW, SHIP)
# plus the two silent classes. Add a shape when a new phase or role starts
# injecting; do NOT add near-duplicates, they inflate the total without
# covering anything new.
SILENT|what does this function do?
SILENT|rename this variable
MEASURE|fix the login bug
MEASURE|let's build a new caching layer for the API
MEASURE|review this PR before I merge it
MEASURE|run the tests
MEASURE|ship it
MEASURE|investigate why pods are crashing in production
